text: では…　わしが　おてほんを　みせて　やるかな！

structure.jp: わしが　おてほんを

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb says you do it for someone below you, as a favour. みせて やる = 'I'll show you'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end is the speaker wondering aloud, like 'I suppose'. みせて やるかな = 'I suppose I'll show you'.
